capabilities: Render ruby (furigana) notation in preview and optionally in source mode
Insert ruby via dialog or directly in the editor
Insert emphasis dots (bouten) on selected text
Remove ruby marks from selected text
Toggle ruby visibility and custom ruby brackets in settings
extras: Ruby delimiters using the half-width pipe | break inside Markdown tables; the full-width pipe ｜ must be used there. The plugin explicitly does not support the Markdown ruby format and points users to obsidian-markdown-furigana for that.
problem: Obsidian does not render the ruby markup conventions used by Japanese novel web sites such as 青空文庫 and 小説家になろう.

relations.evidence: Part of the Ruby parsing code was inspired by obsidian-markdown-furigana plugin.
The localization code is based on the obsidian-commander plugin.

summary: Ruby (furigana) plugin that renders and inserts Japanese novel ruby notation like 「長い｜文章《ぶんしょう》」 in the editor and preview.
